name: Daily digest enhancements — queue count + Stripe status + /queue tip
goal: Enhance scripts/daily-digest.ts: (1) Add getQueueStats(): reads publish-ledger.jsonl count, manual-posts.jsonl count, compute unposted=ledger-recorded. (2) Add queue line to digest: '📋 Queue: N unposted videos ready to post'. (3) Add Stripe status line: '💳 Stripe: 🟢 LIVE' if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY set, '💳 Stripe: 🔴 NOT LIVE (set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY)' if not. (4) Update tip line: include /queue reference. Operator now sees every morning: gate urgency, queue size, Stripe status — all critical operational signals.
rationale: The morning digest shows gate progress and pipeline stats but not: how many videos are ready to post, or whether Stripe is live. Operator has to run /queue and /stripe-status separately. Adding these to the digest makes the morning briefing complete — one message tells the operator everything they need to know to take action.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 file edit + 1 validation script. Direct write.
